demoOnly: Available with the Pilotix server (not in the demo)
resizeCol: Drag to set the width · double-click: automatic width

update.movingSub: A new version is ready, one moment.

appUpdate.titleOffer: New version of the Pilotix app
appUpdate.noteOffer: What changes: the app itself (its start screen, notifications…). Your orders stay the same.
appUpdate.noteRequired: This version is needed to keep working. It takes less than a minute.
appUpdate.old1: Tap « Download the new app »: the file goes to Downloads.
appUpdate.old2: Remove the old Pilotix app (long-press its icon › Uninstall).
appUpdate.old3: Open the downloaded file › Install, then sign in. After that, the app updates itself.
appUpdate.allowNote: Android asks only once: tap « Open settings », turn on « Allow from this source », then come back here.
appUpdate.then: Then Android asks you to confirm.
appUpdate.failed: The download didn't finish. Check the internet and try again.
appUpdate.done: Pilotix app up to date · version {{build}}
